title: ocimum gratissimum var. suave
intro: Ocimum gratissimum var. suave, commonly known as Lemon Basil, is a fragrant and aromatic plant species in the Lamiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and it is valued for its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ocimum gratissimum var. suave include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems, such as coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, including limonene, linalool, and rosmarinic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
